anomalies.impact: The stacked bus has inconsistent 5V pin mapping: J1 supplies 5V on pin 25 instead of pin 27, while pin 27 is not passed through at J1. A stacked module may lose its expected 5V supply or have 5V applied to an unintended contact.

parsed.summary: The schematic places +5V on J1 pin 25 but on J2 pin 27, contrary to the specified pass-through bus mapping. This leaves the intended J1 pin 27 connection open and misroutes the supply.
